# update commands

Every `update` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `update:changelog`

Show applied and available Semitexa package version changes.

```bash
bin/semitexa update:changelog
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |
| `--limit` | yes |
| `--no-remote` | no |
| `--package` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `update:history`

Show the update run journal: past runs, outcomes, package version changes.

```bash
bin/semitexa update:history
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |
| `--limit` | yes |
| `--id` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `update:lint:patches`

Lint every #[AsDataPatch] for required metadata and the data-only boundary.

```bash
bin/semitexa update:lint:patches
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `update:packages:auto`

Run automatic Semitexa framework deployment when enabled and updates are available

```bash
bin/semitexa update:packages:auto
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `update:packages:bootstrap-remote`

Validate and prepare a first remote Semitexa deployment target (Ubuntu 20.04+ only)

```bash
bin/semitexa update:packages:bootstrap-remote
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--target` | yes |
| `--path` | yes |
| `--force-reinitialize` | no |
| `--remote-env-file` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `update:packages:check`

Inspect Semitexa auto deployment status and discover newer stable releases

```bash
bin/semitexa update:packages:check
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--json` | no |

## `update:packages:materialize`

Generate a production-friendly composer manifest with exact Semitexa package versions and VCS repositories

```bash
bin/semitexa update:packages:materialize
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--output` | yes |
| `--write-root` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `update:plan`

Compute the update plan without executing anything.

```bash
bin/semitexa update:plan
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |

## `update:scaffold:rebuild`

Mirror the installer scaffold into this package and regenerate scaffold-manifest.json

```bash
bin/semitexa update:scaffold:rebuild
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--installer-scaffold` | yes |
| `--check` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `update:status`

Show current update status (applied / pending / failed counts).

```bash
bin/semitexa update:status
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--connection` | yes |
